map.→ 打开声誉（管理/评估/提升）策略工具: -> Open the reputation (management / evaluation / improvement) strategy tool
map.危机事件前后各评一次，看危机韧性项是否骤降，评估声誉修复进度。: Score once before and once after a crisis event to see whether the crisis resilience score drops sharply, and assess how far reputation repair has progressed.
map.取决于根因。若低分源于可被验证的事实问题（如质量、合规），修复前提是先把事实问题: It depends on the root cause. If the low score comes from a verifiable factual problem (quality or compliance, say), the first step is closing that factual loop, because the reputation tool is a water level gauge, not a repair kit. If it comes from misunderstanding or an information gap, transparent communication can restore the score fairly quickly. The weak dimensions this tool flags help you set priorities.
map.品牌认知衡量「有多少人知道你、知道什么」，在线声誉衡量「网络声量里的情感与口碑」: Brand awareness measures "how many people know you and what they know", while online reputation measures "the sentiment and word of mouth within the online chatter". A brand can have high awareness (everyone knows it) but poor online reputation (search results are all negative). When both are low it is most dangerous, because negative sentiment spreads quickly on high awareness.
map.在线声誉和品牌认知有什么区别？: What is the difference between online reputation and brand awareness?
map.声誉分低一定能救回来吗？: Can a low reputation score always be recovered?
map.季度品牌健康度盘点时，按品牌认知、公众信任、危机韧性、利益相关方、在线声誉 5: In the quarterly brand health review, score five items 0-5 each - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholders and online reputation - to quantify the reputation level.
map.对企业品牌声誉进行系统化评估，涵盖品牌认知、公众信任、危机韧性、利益相关方关系、: A systematic evaluation of corporate brand reputation across 5 dimensions - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholder relations and online reputation - to help formulate reputation improvement strategies.
map.自动标红 ≤2 分的薄弱维度，作为下季度声誉提升的优先投入方向。: Weak dimensions scoring 2 or below are automatically flagged red and become the priority investment areas for next quarter's reputation improvement.
map.：5 个维度各 0~5 分：①品牌认知 ②公众信任 ③危机韧性 ④利益相关方（员: : five dimensions scored 0-5 each: 1) brand awareness, 2) public trust, 3) crisis resilience, 4) stakeholders (employees, regulators, community) and 5) online reputation. Total = sum of the five, maximum 25. Grades: 21 and above is reputation outstanding, 17 and above good, 12 and above average, below 12 reputation risk. Any dimension at 2 or below is listed as "dimension needing improvement".
map.：某成熟品牌：认知5+信任5+韧性4+相关方5+在线4 = 23 分，判声誉卓越: : a mature brand scores awareness 5 + trust 5 + resilience 4 + stakeholders 5 + online 4 = 23, judged reputation outstanding with no weak items. By contrast a brand that just weathered a quality complaint scores awareness 2 + trust 1 + resilience 2 + stakeholders 1 + online 1 = 7, judged reputation risk, with all five dimensions flagged as needing improvement. That is not a single-point problem but a systemic collapse of trust, calling for overall reputation repair rather than local patching.
